name: HTC Corporation
summary: HTC Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, assembles, processes, and sells virtual reality devices and smart mobile devices in Taiwan and internationally. The company provides VIVE AI glasses, smartphones, blockchain phones, and 5G hub products, as well as accessories. It also provides marketing, repair, and after-sales services; human resources management; virtual reality platform software development and promotion services; smart mobile devices examination and technique consultations; and online/download media services. In addition, the company engages in digital art; design, research, and development of application software; medical technology and health care;…
